patch_description: Restructure the solver into three stages: (1) graph preprocessing, (2) candidate route generation per destination (k shortest paths + load-aware Dijkstra re-runs), and (3) a joint cross-destination assignment pass. Destinations are processed in decreasing path-cost order, and for each partition the candidate path that reuses edges already committed for that same partition gets a reuse bonus (inverting the old load penalty into a reward). If transfer cost is effectively charged per unique edge or aggregate flows are discounted, this collapses traffic onto shared multicast-style trees and cuts redundant transfers, lowering total cost. Output format (`[s, t, G[s][t]]` appends) is unchanged.
